name: Aisu Paradise
source:
Welcome to Aisu Paradise! You are Tetsuya, a young employee at Della Puena, an ice-cream parlor that’s been having some financial issues in the past few months.

Although Tetsuya's dream is to become an adult film producer and director, he’s staying at the shop to help Natsuko, his sexy tsundere store manager and roommate, and Sachi, a cute and charming new employee.

The main "problem" is… Both girls seem to like you. And it’s gonna be your duty to wisely choose which one to date without hurting the other and keeping your job at the same time... Will it be Sachi ? Will it be Natsuko ? Or will it be both ?

It's all up to you… After all, maybe these beautiful girls can help to fulfill your most lewd dreams…

[From [url=https://maranyo.itch.io/aisu-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到冰淇淋天堂！你是Tetsuya，一名在Della Puena工作的年轻员工。这家冰淇淋店过去几个月一直面临财务问题。

Tetsuya的梦想是成为成人电影制片人与导演，但他留在店里帮助性感傲娇的店长兼室友Natsuko，以及可爱迷人的新员工Sachi。

最大的问题是……两个女孩似乎都喜欢你。你必须明智地选择约会对象，不能伤害另一个人，同时还要保住工作……会是Sachi？会是Natsuko？还是两个人都要？

一切由你决定……毕竟，也许这些漂亮女孩能帮你实现最淫荡的梦想……

[来源：[url=https://maranyo.itch.io/aisu-paradise]itch.io[/url]]
